deliverables: Custodial wallet onboarding for Sellout users
Public launch campaign and trade-show activations
Public metrics dashboard and governance reporting
request.recipient: Anvil Development Agency, Inc. / Intersect as budget administrator
request.what: Fund Phase 2 of a production Cardano-native ticketing platform operated by Sellout.io and built by Anvil Development Agency.

claims.claim: Phase 1 is already live on Cardano mainnet with on-chain event creation, CIP-68 ticket minting, transfers, and attendance verification funded by Sellout with over $130,000.
The proposal requests 4,969,231 ada, approximately $1,093,231 at $0.22 per ADA, including a 3% Intersect administration fee, over 8 months.
Phase 2 will deliver a secondary marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, an independent audit, and launch marketing.
Sellout has 200,000+ registered users, has issued 250,000+ tickets to date, and currently supports 350+ events annually.
The Yellowstone Club 2026 concert series is presented as a contracted anchor deployment projected to move over $6 million through Cardano in Year 1.
The proposer commits to repay $1,093,231 to the Cardano Treasury through a revenue-share mechanism using 25% of all fees until full reimbursement and 5% thereafter.
The proposal says funds will be administered by Intersect through the Sundae Labs TRSC/PSSC framework with milestone-based disbursement, independent oversight, and public dashboard tracking.
The proposal projects 12-month outcomes of 200+ events on-chain, 75,000+ CIP-68 NFT tickets, 150,000+ on-chain interactions, $6 million+ ticket revenue on-chain, and 20,000+ new wallets.
The proposal states all on-chain metrics will be independently verifiable through Cardano explorer data and policy-ID tracking, with a public metrics dashboard live in M5.
The proposal states Anvil/Sellout have not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

summary: The document requests 4,969,231 ada for an 8-month Phase 2 buildout of a Cardano-native ticketing platform, with milestone gating, Intersect/Sundae TRSC/PSSC administration, projected enterprise adoption metrics, and a contractual revenue-share repayment commitment.
